challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has skewed demand for seasonal goods, exposing that our KPI definitions do not account for weather driven spikes. #model_monica# wants to automate the KPI tracking to capture these shifts in real time, while #efficiency_emilia# prefers to keep the process manual to ensure every metric aligns with the broader business strategy. #efficiency_emilia# might accept an automated solution if it clearly supports the agreed business goals.

output.content: I am open to letting the system handle the nightly KPI refresh if it directly serves the agreed business goals. I will accept losing the manual review step where I currently adjust each metric to fit the broader product strategy. In return, I need the automated output to align perfectly with our organizational roadmap. If the automation drifts from those strategic targets, I will revert to the manual process immediately. The trade is clear: I give up the hands on control over metric definition only if the automation proves it supports the exact objectives we set for the season.
